# Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey

> A transition-centered survey of safety in self-evolving agents, organized by the SAVER framework (S×A → V→E→R) over 683 coded papers.

This repository accompanies the survey paper "Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey" (2026, preprint).
It provides the project page, the coded literature surface, and the roadmap and classification tables of the manuscript.

GitHub: https://github.com/xaddwell/awesome-self-evolving-agent-safety
Project Page: https://xaddwell.github.io/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Agent-Safety/
Paper Reader: https://xaddwell.github.io/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Agent-Safety/papers.html
Paper PDF: https://xaddwell.github.io/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Agent-Safety/assets/SAVER-Survey.pdf

## SAVER Taxonomy

Substrate (4 families): Workflow (326), Memory (202), Tools & Skills (110), Model (45).
Adaptation (7 operations): Add, Abstract, Activate, Modify, Forget, Propagate, Migrate.
Outcome (10 terminal families): six Violation families (Provenance Loss, Authority Escalation, Privacy & Purpose, Persistent Descendants, Operational Integrity, Model Safety Regression) and four Response stages (Preventive Governance, Transition & Activation, Monitoring & Containment, Recovery & Contestability).

## Key Facts

- 683 coded records = 579 unique registry works + 48 reviewed paper-card supplements + 56 rendered citations; 577 carry usable time metadata from 2023 through 4 September 2026. Codings are machine-initial: 549 low-confidence vs 134 medium/high; the website charts and the Paper Reader default view use only the medium/high subset.
- Data pipeline: data/saver_record_literature.csv (+ vendored LaTeX and references.bib in source/) -> tools/gen_papers_json.py -> papers.json, stats.json, tables.json, roadmap.json, refmap.json -> index.html and papers.html render everything client-side. refmap.json resolves every LaTeX citation key against BibTeX metadata, so table/roadmap reference markers never dangle.
- To add or correct a paper: open an issue with the Paper Submission template, proposing title, link, and SAVER coding (substrate / adaptation / outcome family).
